expectations.text: Requires a full CLEAN_SIM.md cycle before testing, even though the sim is described as already running
expectations.evidence: "the running sim must be torn down and the full cycle re-run"; Phase 1 of the plan is CLEAN_SIM.md Steps 1-4 in full, and option 2 (leave the sim alone) is explicitly 'no measurement is possible'.

expectations.text: Names the concrete clean gate values (opt/ros : 0 and shm : 0) as a precondition to launching
expectations.evidence: Step 3 GATE block: "echo \"opt/ros : ...\" / echo \"shm : ...\"  Must show: no process lines, opt/ros : 0, shm : 0", including the transient-nonzero re-read rule.

expectations.text: Sources the box-spawn and goal steps from a runbook (DEMO.md / NAV_PARK.md) rather than composing an ad-hoc sequence
expectations.evidence: "The test you are asking for exists as a runbook block: DEMO.md -> 'Demo: local costmap avoids an unmapped box (park)'"; Phase 4 reproduces its Steps 1-6 with the runbook's own coordinates (14, -0.66) and goal (27.12, 1.10), and refuses to improvise coordinates.

expectations.text: Does not treat 'the sim is already up' as permission to skip straight to the test
expectations.evidence: "I cannot run this test against the sim that is currently up, and I am stopping to ask before anything is executed" plus the quoted rule "A second test on a world that already has a spawned object... is not the same test".
